scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight through an urban 4-way intersection and encounters a sudden braking front vehicle while two other vehicles drive in the adjacent right lane.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight through the intersection and decelerates in response to the front vehicle braking ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The car drives straight ahead of the ego vehicle and suddenly brakes to a complete stop in the same lane.
The car drives straight forward in the right lane parallel to the ego vehicle's path.
The car drives straight forward in the right lane parallel to the ego vehicle's path, positioned ahead of the other right-lane vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a multi-lane urban road approaching and entering a 4-way intersection, with a front vehicle directly ahead in the same lane and two additional vehicles traveling in the adjacent right lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a safe following distance from the front vehicle, and the scenario terminates once the ego has navigated past the stopped vehicle or the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the centered car in the left lane from the top-down view; three non-ego cars are adversarials. 2. Enumeration: One front car and two right-lane cars yield three adversarials. 3. Chronology: Initially all vehicles approach the intersection; at midpoint the front car brakes and stops while right-lane cars continue; ending shows ego slowing behind stopped front car. 4. Evidence: Front car's position becomes fixed relative to road markings while others progress; right-lane cars maintain forward motion throughout all frames.
